name: freezing-gambit-sacrifices-a-chessman-and-debuffs-the-target
notes: Freezing Gambit: sacrifice the Pawn Piece (additional cost), pay 2, give the opposing champion's attacks -3 POWER. The effect used to never run and the Chessman was never sacrificed. (Only the -3 POWER mode of the 'choose one or both' is implemented; the negate mode is not.) Its additional cost (sacrifice a Chessman ally) was also never paid: the play prereq only checked that a Chessman ally existed. The cost is now declared with Golden Gambit's in DoActivateCard.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Freezing Gambit's effect was generated as an $enterAbilities entry, but it is an Action that never enters the field, so activating it only paid its cost and sent it to the graveyard: the effect never ran. Fix: OnCardActivated() runs an Action's enter ability as its resolution effect when the card has no activation ability of its own. Its additional cost (sacrifice a Chessman ally) was also never paid: the play prereq only checked that a Chessman ally existed. The cost is now declared with Golden Gambit's in DoActivateCard.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php OnCardActivated; Custom/GameLogic.php DoActivateCard Chessman-sacrifice cost
